author: Andrew Fisher

checks.name: Opening completes once when the map becomes ready
Navigation away cancels a pending opening
A failed opening stops and gives a retry instruction
Desktop map ends above the footer and main padding
Phone uses its actual map top
Host scrolling cannot progressively enlarge the map
Full screen reserves its own bottom edge
Hidden tab is not resized to an invalid area
Short viewport keeps a usable minimum without a fixed 420px CSS minimum

scope: CPU behavioural fixtures; real desktop and phone geometry is checked separately in the browser.
